ebisu.name: Ebisu
ebisu.title: Fortune of fishermen and luck
ebisu.sleeping: Moss covers the roof and the bell lies in the grass. Somewhere inside, Ebisu is fast asleep. Fill the offering box to wake him.
ebisu.awake: Ebisu laughs from his little hall. The sea feels deeper and kinder: the old pier is back, and stranger fish swim below it.
unlocks: Ebisu’s pier: walk out to sea and fish the deep water
Five deep-sea fish: some only bite in the morning, at dusk or at night
Bait at Hana’s stall: rare fish bite more often (only used when you land one)

daikoku.name: Daikoku
daikoku.title: Fortune of the harvest and plenty
daikoku.sleeping: The roped stone beside the shrine is warm to the touch. Daikoku sleeps on his rice bales; a full storehouse would wake him.
daikoku.awake: Daikoku shakes his lucky mallet and laughs. A stone mill and a kitchen stand ready: the harvest can become something more.
unlocks: A stone mill: rice into flour, tea into matcha, beans into kinako
A kitchen: cook dishes, and discover recipes by trying ingredients together
Dishes sell for much more than what goes into them, and make fine presents
